name: Takimine Mikiya
source: The protagonist, Takimine Mikiya is a priest apprentice of the Takimine clan. A mild-mannered pacifist and a relative of the heroines. He’s dispatched to help Otowa house exterminating an abnormally massive amount of demons emerging in Minamori’s land. Mikiya is remarkably skilled in Onmyouji spells (able to perform one without incantation), various shikigamis summoning, medical purification, healing spell, and a very strong spiritual power. Though his Onmyouji destruction spell (by projecting it through kick and fist) is able to deal high damage, it’s still required access and full spiritual power preparation by the user. It’s makes him powerful yet vulnerable to enemy’s counterattack. During one of the confrontation, Mikiya having his power sealed by a Spider specter. Thus keeping him from front line’s fighting as often as the more combat oriented Otowa sisters. Mikiya tends to rely on Keika, Hatsuka, and his shikigamis when direct combat is required. Later, as explained at Keika’s ending, Mikiya occasionally travels to another cities and reappears as temporary lecturer in it’s sequel, TsukiKagura. Mikiya also reappears in Aozora Magiccer!! as the sequel of Youko’s ending.
